content.value_statement: Drug discovery ML work needs consistent datasets, splits, and benchmark metrics. This skill guides Claude, Codex, and Claude Code through PyTDC workflows.
actual_capabilities: Guide PyTDC installation and setup for therapeutic ML projects.
Load single-instance and multi-instance TDC datasets by task and name.
Apply scaffold, random, cold, and temporal train validation test splits.
Use TDC Evaluator metrics for classification and regression tasks.
Run ADMET benchmark group examples with the 5-seed protocol.
Score generated molecules with QED, SA, LogP, and target oracles.
limitations: Dataset downloads require internet access and local cache storage.
Some oracles require optional dependencies or external API access.
Users must provide their own model training and prediction code.
Oracle scores are estimates and do not replace laboratory validation.

use_cases.title: Prepare ADME datasets
use_cases.description: Load ADME and toxicity datasets with scaffold splits for repeatable model training and validation.

use_cases.title: Benchmark therapeutic models
use_cases.description: Use benchmark groups and 5-seed results to compare models with standard metrics.

use_cases.title: Rank generated molecules
use_cases.description: Review oracle scores and constraints before prioritizing generated molecules for follow-up analysis.

prompt_templates.title: Load a Dataset
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner setup for a single PyTDC dataset.
prompt_templates.prompt: Load the Caco2_Wang dataset with a scaffold split, then summarize the train, validation, and test sizes.

prompt_templates.title: Choose Metrics
prompt_templates.scenario: Select evaluation metrics for a prediction task.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use PyTDC to choose metrics for a toxicity classifier and explain how to report ROC-AUC, PR-AUC, and F1.

prompt_templates.title: Plan Benchmarking
prompt_templates.scenario: Prepare a reproducible ADMET benchmark run.
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a 5-seed ADMET benchmark plan for my model, including required splits, prediction format, and summary metrics.

prompt_templates.title: Design Oracle Workflow
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced molecule generation with multiple objectives.
prompt_templates.prompt: Design a molecule generation workflow that balances QED, synthetic accessibility, LogP, and target oracle scores for candidate ranking.

output: The response names the dataset, task type, split method, and seed.
It reports train, validation, and test counts in a compact summary.
It notes which label and molecule columns are needed for modeling.
The plan lists required seeds, unchanged splits, prediction collection, and final aggregation.
It recommends reporting mean, standard deviation, metric name, and model settings.
It flags that dummy predictions must be replaced before submission.

output_examples.input: Rank generated molecules using multiple oracles.
output: The output explains each oracle goal in plain language.
It suggests a weighted scoring approach and constraint checks.
It reminds the user that oracle results need expert review.

best_practices: Use scaffold or cold splits when testing chemical generalization.
Run all required seeds and report mean with standard deviation.
Check dataset labels, units, and task type before training models.
anti_patterns: Do not compare models trained on different split strategies.
Do not submit benchmark results from placeholder or dummy predictions.
Do not treat oracle scores as proof of safety or clinical efficacy.

faq.question: What is PyTDC used for?
faq.answer: PyTDC provides curated therapeutic ML datasets, benchmark groups, evaluators, splits, and molecule generation oracles.

faq.question: Which datasets can this skill help with?
faq.answer: It covers ADME, toxicity, DTI, DDI, protein interaction, quantum mechanics, molecule generation, and related therapeutic tasks.

faq.question: Does the skill train models for me?
faq.answer: It provides workflow guidance and templates. You still supply the model implementation and predictions.

faq.question: Why are scaffold splits recommended?
faq.answer: Scaffold splits test whether a model generalizes to new chemical structures, which is important for molecular prediction.

faq.question: Can I use it without internet access?
faq.answer: Some datasets and resources must be downloaded first. Cached data can support later offline work.

faq.question: Are oracle scores experimental results?
faq.answer: No. Oracle scores are computational estimates for screening and ranking, not laboratory validation.
